messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a coordinated deploy for API v3.4, runtime 2.9.1, console patch, and router shard config change. Looking for a morning change window (US-west) tomorrow.

devon: +1 for morning. What's the risk matrix? Any schema or contract bumps between api <-> runtime?

sanjay: Runtime change is a kernel batching tweak + KV cache eviction threshold bump. No API surface changes. Router needs a small route table update to shard traffic by customer-tier header. Console is a UI-only fix (release notes link: https://intranet/release/3.4).

kevin: TL;DR — runtime and router are interdependent during the traffic shift. If runtime has a regression on kv-cache, router's staged traffic could amplify error rate. Recommend canary at 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m with smoke checks.

maria: Sounds reasonable. Can we pin API to v3.4.0 for the first 2 hours to avoid auto-roll forward? I want rollback deterministic.

deploy-bot: preflight checks starting...
- dependency-check: OK (api->runtime compat)
- version-pin-status: OK (api pinned to 3.4.0 in router config)
- infra-capacity: OK (extra GPU pool reserved for runtime)
- cert-check: OK

lia: Quick note on rollback surface — console changes are feature-flagged. We can toggle to hide new UI instantly. Router route table rollback is a two-step: shift traffic back then revert shard config. Runtime rollback requires staging KV flush. Need runbook steps in release doc.

maria: I'll author a short runbook snippet. Proposed rollout plan:
1) deploy runtime 2.9.1 to dedicated pool (no traffic)
2) sanity smoke (`/health` and qps latency)
3) update router to canary 5% -> wait 15m -> run smoke suite
4) if OK, console patch -> 25% router -> 30m -> expand to 100% over 2 waves
5) unpin API after 2h if all good

devon: Add automatic rollback triggers: error-rate > 2% OR 95th latency bump > 200ms over baseline => immediate rollback. Also add alert to #eng-oncall and page SRE on critical.

deploy-bot: added triggers to deploy job: `error_rate_threshold=0.02`, `p95_latency_delta_ms=200`. Will post rollout events to this thread.

sanjay: One more: when we move router to 25%, runtime needs to have KV cache warming enabled; otherwise first-wave latency spikes. I'll add a toggle to the runtime config.

maria: Great. Who's on-call for the window?

kevin: I'm primary eng oncall 0800-1200 PT tomorrow. Lia will be console lead, Sanjay runtime, Devon will monitor API metrics.

maria: OK locked. I'll update release notes and PR the runbook into infra/runbooks/deploys.md. Final check: any database migrations?

lia: No DB migrations in this release.

devon: Approved from API side. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduling deploy at 2026-03-22T15:00:00Z (change window: 2h). Canary steps configured. Watch for deploy events here.

maria: Thanks — please ping when first canary is live.
